cases.name: startup: 19200 8N1 with the receive NMI, 80 columns, ASCII font, blank screen
printable text, CR/LF/Tab, ESC Y, ESC A-D, home, reverse and colours
erase to end/start of line and screen, erase line, clear screen
insert/delete line, scrolling both ways, save/restore cursor
wrap on and off, cursor on and off, unknown sequences ignored, positions clamped
keys are sent as ASCII; cursor keys as ESC A-D; Del as backspace
the 256-byte ring keeps the first 255 bytes and counts the rest as dropped
F8 returns to the desktop: VDC, font, screen mode, NMI vector, keys and ACIA restored
without an ACIA the terminal restores everything and returns
